title: Deus — SLO Overview
description: Availability and latency SLOs of the deus journeys and services: error budgets, burn rates and alerts.

list.name: Critical alerts
list.expr: max by (alertname, target, slo, deployment) (ALERTS{alertname=~"Deus.*", alertstate="firing", severity="critical"})

list.name: Node restarts
list.expr: (max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) > max_over_time((max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)))[30m:1m] offset 1m)) * on (node) group_left (label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) max by (node, label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) (kube_node_labels)
list.textFormat: Pool {{label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool}} ({{label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning}}): spot preemption, upgrade or repair; its pods were rescheduled

list.name: Container restarts
list.expr: (changes(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"(.+-)?deus"}[1m]) > 0) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left (reason) max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"(.+-)?deus"})

panels.title: Journey SLOs
panels.description: What users do, measured on the service that answers it. A journey that burns while its service looks fine usually fails in a dependency the service calls.

targets.expr: sum by (target, slo) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate1h{kind="journey"} / on (target, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio))
sum by (target, slo) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate6h{kind="journey"} / on (target, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio))

sum by (target, slo) (clamp_max(clamp_min(slo:error_budget_remaining:ratio{kind="journey"}, 0) * 2592000 / on (target, slo, kind) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate1h{kind="journey"} / on (target, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio)), 31536000))

panels.title: Services without ready pods
panels.description: A service with no ready pod is down even though its SLO rows stay quiet. Alert: DeusServiceDown.

panels.title: Ready pods per service
panels.description: Share of each service's desired replicas that are available. Orange: some replicas are restarting, rolling out or rescheduled after a Spot preemption. Red 0%: the service is down.

panels.title: Burning fastest now
panels.description: The journey or service SLO with the highest burn rate over the last hour. Below 1 its budget lasts longer than 30 days; at 14.4 DeusSLOBurnRateCritical pages.

targets.expr: topk(1, slo:sli_error:ratio_rate1h / on (target, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio) > 0.1) or on () label_replace(label_replace(max(slo:sli_error:ratio_rate1h / on (target, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio)), "target", "every SLO", "", ""), "slo", "below 0.1x", "", "")

panels.title: SLO data in window
panels.description: How much data the 30-day window really holds. On a recently created cluster the budget figures describe only this period, and a short incident looks much larger.

panels.title: SLO rules last evaluated
panels.description: Age of the newest SLI sample. If vmalert or VictoriaMetrics is down, this dashboard silently goes stale.

panels.title: Availability — requests answered without a 5xx
panels.description: Each service's share of non-5xx responses over 30 days against its objective. Burn rate 1 spends the budget in exactly 30 days; alerts page at 14.4 (1h) or 6 (6h). Budget gone in = remaining budget at the current 1h burn rate. Most at risk first; click a service to drill down.

targets.expr: sum by (target, slo) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate1h{kind="service", slo="availability"} / on (target, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio))
sum by (target, slo) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate6h{kind="service", slo="availability"} / on (target, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio))

sum by (target, slo) (clamp_max(clamp_min(slo:error_budget_remaining:ratio{kind="service", slo="availability"}, 0) * 2592000 / on (target, slo, kind) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate1h{kind="service", slo="availability"} / on (target, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio)), 31536000))

panels.title: Latency — requests faster than the service's threshold
panels.description: Each service's share of requests answered within its threshold over 30 days. Burn rate 1 spends the budget in exactly 30 days; alerts page at 14.4 (1h) or 6 (6h). Budget gone in = remaining budget at the current 1h burn rate. Most at risk first; click a service to drill down.

targets.expr: sum by (target, slo) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate1h{kind="service", slo="latency"} / on (target, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio))
sum by (target, slo) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate6h{kind="service", slo="latency"} / on (target, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio))

sum by (target, slo) (clamp_max(clamp_min(slo:error_budget_remaining:ratio{kind="service", slo="latency"}, 0) * 2592000 / on (target, slo, kind) (slo:sli_error:ratio_rate1h{kind="service", slo="latency"} / on (target, slo, kind) (1 - slo:objective:ratio)), 31536000))

panels.title: Burn rate — 1h window
panels.description: Pages when both the 1h and 5m burn rates exceed 14.4 (2% of the 30-day budget in one hour).

panels.title: Burn rate — 6h window
panels.description: Pages when both the 6h and 30m burn rates exceed 6 (5% of the 30-day budget in six hours).

panels.title: Journey SLIs — 1h
panels.description: Share of good requests over the last hour: availability = not 5xx, latency = faster than the threshold. The dashed lines are the objectives. The axis stops at 95%: lines leaving it at the bottom are incidents (Min in the legend).

panels.title: Service SLIs — 1h
panels.description: Share of good requests over the last hour: availability = not 5xx, latency = faster than the threshold. The dashed lines are the objectives. The axis stops at 95%: lines leaving it at the bottom are incidents (Min in the legend).

panels.title: Error budget remaining (30d)
panels.description: Below 0 the SLO is violated for the 30-day window.

panels.title: Bad requests ratio — 5m
panels.description: Share of requests that are 5xx (availability) or slower than the threshold (latency).

panels.title: Deus alerts — firing and pending
panels.description: Alert state written by vmalert (ALERTS series).

options.content:
| SLI | Good events | Valid events | Objective (30 days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Availability** | responses that are not 5xx (4xx are the caller's mistake and count as good) | all HTTP requests | 99.5% |
| **Latency** | responses faster than the latency threshold | all HTTP requests | 99% |

**Services**: each service's own requests, `/openapi` excluded; threshold 500 ms (identity 2500 ms, payments 1000 ms, reporting 1000 ms).

**Journeys**: what a user does, measured on the service that answers it:

| Journey | What | Requests | Threshold |
|---|---|---|---|
| **sign-in** | Sign in and register | `service_name="identity", http_request_method="POST", http_route="/api/identity/auth/*"` | 2500 ms |
| **invoicing** | Create, issue and void invoices | `service_name="sales", http_request_method=~"POST|PUT|DELETE", http_route=~"/api/sales/.*"` | 1000 ms |
| **payments** | Record receipts and vendor payments | `service_name="payments", http_request_method="POST", http_route=~"/api/payments/.*"` | 1000 ms |
| **bills** | Enter and approve vendor bills | `service_name="purchases", http_request_method=~"POST|PUT|DELETE", http_route=~"/api/purchases/.*"` | 1000 ms |
| **reports** | Financial statements | `service_name="reporting", http_route=~"/api/reporting/.*"` | 1000 ms |
| **browse** | Every page load (GET /api/...) | `http_request_method="GET", http_route=~"/api/.*", service_name!="identity"` | 500 ms |

**Error budget and burn rate.** Budget = 1 − objective over a rolling 30 days. Burn rate = error ratio / budget: 1 spends
the budget in exactly 30 days. Pages (critical): above 14.4 over 1h and 5m, or above 6 over 6h and 30m. Tickets
(warning): above 3 over 1d and 2h, or above 1 over 3d and 6h. The rules are generated with this text by
`tools/dashboards` into `infrastructure/configs/victoria-metrics-k8s-stack/base/deus.yaml`.
